title: Had a Dream about a Girl I Have Never Met, but Felt a Fondness For When I Woke Up...

meta.final_emotion: Somber/feeling of emotional severance upon waking; fondness for the girl

locations.location_name: Near my hometown (small Texas town ~1000 people)

interactions.description: Spent time together with an unknown girl named "Astrid" in different parts of the dream-version of the dreamer's hometown; mutual sense of connection/fondness.

interactions.description: Astrid met the dreamer's mother; dreamer recalls either Astrid referred to herself as the dreamer's girlfriend or the dreamer referred to her as his girlfriend to his mother.

Astrid wearing a greenish-yellow extended cardigan/coat.

entities_involved.description: Astrid; asked about living in a small town; implied origin near Eastern Pennsylvania based on dreamer's recollection of an area code.
